newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Actress cheers Bulgarians with breast sculpture.
newsitem.headline: Actress cheers Bulgarians with breast sculpture.

text.p: A leading Bulgarian actress has decided to take her compatriots' minds off the economic crisis by having a plaster cast of her breasts made for display in the National Theatre.

"I was fed up with constant comments on the currency board so I said one day let's talk busts instead of boards," National Theatre actress Anya Pencheva told the daily 24 Hours in an interview published on Thursday.
Bulgaria is discussing the pros and cons of a strict monetary regime which would effectively peg the collapsing lev to the dollar, bringing with it severe budget spending cuts.
"It is a pity to focus everything on the (currency) board when there are such beautiful breasts around," said Pencheva, who is also a long-standing local sex symbol.
